top_signals.title: Fed’s Collins Says Rate Hike Will Help Reach Inflation Goal
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said she supported last week’s decision to raise interest rates, which she said would help bring inflation back to the central bank’s 2% target.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Waver as Trump’s UN Speech in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Hopes for diplomatic efforts to revive energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices lower, easing inflation angst and leaving stocks wavering near their all-time highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Donald Trump claims to have ‘made peace’ in Middle East in UN address
top_signals.summary: US president touted administration’s foreign and domestic achievements
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mercedes rides the AI Wayve with self-driving deal
top_signals.summary: Mercedes-Benz will put British start-up Wayve’s self-driving technology into its cars within two years, handing the London AI firm its third major production deal in less than nine months. top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: Animoca Chairman Yat Siu says that the 'corporate agility must take precedence' over pursuing the Currenc merger.
